review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis plus automated PatAgent checklist; not expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.
purpose: Optional constrained reconstruction of missing CCD ligand heavy atoms and explicit named Zn2+ Amber/TIP3P model support in DynaMol. Validate structure identity, unchanged observed coordinates, atom correspondence, opt-in intent, uncertainty labels, and finite compatible native force-field setup; no biological pose, metal coordination accuracy, affinity or converged dynamics claim.

reproducibility.budget: Isolated data/integration-checks/chemistry-repair only; user datasets read or copied, never edited. Up to four small organic component cases (≤80 heavy atoms), ≤32 deterministic conformer attempts each, ≤200 local MMFF/UFF iterations per attempt. At most 2 CPU threads, 300 seconds per native parameterization/test process. OpenMM finite-energy/force-field smoke systems ≤50000 atoms, ≤100 bounded minimization iterations if needed, zero dynamics integration/production MD. No GPU, cloud, broad molecule generation or long jobs.

data.policy: Full CCD identity/bond order/stereochemistry must be unambiguous and observed atom names/elements a compatible subset. Preserve observed heavy-atom coordinates exactly; label new coordinates as modeled with seed, atom map, missing-atom inventory and low-confidence provenance. Only explicit per-residue opt-in may reconstruct or exclude. Reject unsupported graph/stereo/covalent identity, too-few/degenerate anchors or gross clashes. Named monatomic Zn2+ requires matching element/declared-charge consistency; model uses installed Amber TIP3P nonbonded parameters, not a bonded/polarizable coordination or oxidation-state model.

validation.status: Preflight: identity/source checks completed; implementation smokes and final review pending.
validation.scope: Synthetic known controls plus copied 6A93 monomer 1PE instances; assert unchanged observed coordinates/source hashes, exact completed atom graph, deterministic seeds, no default hidden repair/removal, finite setup, exclusion provenance, backend/UI readiness agreement and saved warnings.

comparison.notes: Software/geometric controls only; reconstructed unobserved atoms are not held-out experimental coordinates or proof of native pose accuracy.
